text:
meera: Heads-up — Bluejay just uploaded their adapter stack for validation. Need a quick smoke pack to check compatibility + quantized behavior. TL;DR: two LoRA adapters, small tokenizer patch, target int4/int8 runs.

alex: On it. Which base model and adapter order?

jamal: Base is gptx-7b-cust. Adapters should be applied in this order: dialog.lora -> instruct.lora. Tokenizer patch adds a couple of special tokens (\u003ccust_tok\u003e) and a numeric remapping.

sara: Flagging tokenizer changes — we saw embedding/perplexity drift when token ids shifted last quarter.

meera: Exactly. Smokepack requirements: 1) tokenization consistency checks, 2) perplexity baseline vs float32, 3) top-1 token distribution diffs on a small prompt set, 4) simple regen A/B on ~20 prompts. Also include a tiny embeddings drift check.

alex: I'll assemble a quick eval pack: 25 prompts (10 dialog, 10 instruction, 5 edge cases including numerics). Will run int8 then int4.

jamal: Add KV-cache warmstart (prefix) to the runs to catch cold-start token jumps. Also include a fallback policy note: route to int8 if int4 top-1 drift > 0.15 for any prompt.

ci-bot: CI run queued: run/bluejay-smokepack-3245678901. Status: queued.

alex: Run command I'm using locally:

```
python eval_pack.py --model gptx-7b-cust \ 
  --adapters dialog.lora,instruct.lora \ 
  --quant int4,int8 \ 
  --prompts smoke_prompts.json \ 
  --warmstart-prefix "[warm]" \ 
  --out bluejay-smoke.json
```

sara: Also include embeddings similarity checks (cos sim) against 5 reference vectors and log mean/std.

meera: And please log token-level probabilities and flag any top-1 probability shift > 0.15 between float32 and quant runs.

jamal: Will add tokenmap tests into the harness and push a small PR.

ci-bot: CI run started: run/bluejay-smokepack-3245678901 — step: setup

jamal: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/827 — adds tokenmap test, warmstart step, and fallback policy metadata.

alex: :thumbsup: starting int8 run now. Will kick int4 after int8 artifact validated.

ci-bot: CI run finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bluejay/3245678901/results.zip

meera: Nice. Alex — can you diff top-1 tokens across runs and paste any prompts with shift > 0.15?

alex: Short summary from results.zip:
- prompt_07: top-1 shift 0.22 (numeric formatting change)
- prompt_12: token aliasing caused top-1 shift 0.18
All other prompts show shifts < 0.1.

sara: Confirms tokenizer patch is causing boundary issues on numerics. Recommend adding a remap/pre-tokenize step in customer's tokenizer and retesting.

meera: Agreed. Plan: propose int8 as short-term mitigation and schedule tokenizer fix. I'll draft the customer note with the artifacts and recommended next steps.

alex: I can prepare a minimal repro (prompt 7 + 12) and a suggested tokenizer patch diff. Will upload to the same S3 folder.

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/bluejay/3245678901/repro_prompt7_12.tar.gz

meera: Thanks all — good quick cycle. Follow-ups: jamal to iterate tokenizer tests, alex to prep customer repro + instruction, sara to add embeddings drift graphs. I'll loop in account team after we have the patch timeline. :calendar:
